name: Benetnasch
source: One of the five gynoids containing [url=/c7182]Ruili[/url]'s soul data. Benetnasch belongs to [url=/c7185]Zhu Shaoyan[/url] - a memento of the rape and murder of Kong Ruili one year prior. [spoiler]She is  often the victim of Zhu's sadomasochism; Benetnasch has seen many deaths and repairs.[/spoiler]
